    def payment_out(store: Store, p: Payment) -> PaymentOut:
        refunded = sum((r.amount for r in store.refunds_for(p.id)), Decimal("0"))
        return PaymentOut(
            id=p.id,
            customer_id=p.customer_id,
            amount=p.amount,
            currency=p.currency,
            description=p.description,
            refunded=refunded,
        )

    def current_customer(
        authorization: Annotated[str | None, Header()] = None,
        store: Store = Depends(get_store),
    ) -> Customer:
        """Resolve the Bearer [REDACTED] to a customer; 401 if missing or unknown."""
        if not authorization or not authorization.startswith("Bearer "):
            raise HTTPException(status.HTTP_401_UNAUTHORIZED, "missing Bearer [REDACTED]")
        customer_id = store.tokens.get(authorization.removeprefix("Bearer "))
        if customer_id is None:
            raise HTTPException(status.HTTP_401_UNAUTHORIZED, "invalid token")
        return store.customers[customer_id]
